title: Sourdough Pie Crust

ingredients: 1 tsp (5g) white vinegar or apple cider vinegar
directions: Grate the cold butter into a large mixing bowl. Add the flour, salt, and sugar and toss together with a fork, making sure the butter is coated and separated. Use a bench scraper or pastry cutter to cut the butter into the flour mixture until it forms large crumbles.

Add the sourdough discard and vinegar and use a fork to incorporate them. Switch to your hands and press the dough together until there are no dry bits. (If the dough is too dry, add a teaspoon of ice water.)
Form the dough into a disk shape and wrap in plastic wrap. Use a rolling pin to flatten the disk. Chill for at least 2 hours or up to 4 days.
Proceed with your pie recipe directions.

notes: Dough can be stored in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 3 months. Double the ingredients for 2 pie crusts.
